top_stories.title: Why Walmart and OpenAI Are Shaking Up Their Agentic Shopping Deal
top_stories.summary: Walmart and OpenAI have entered a partnership to experiment with agentic shopping experiences, utilizing AI agents to facilitate personalized consumer retail assistance. This deal signals a significant step for AI-driven commerce and could influence the broader adoption of conversational AI in enterprise and retail sectors.

top_stories.title: Snowflake launches Project SnowWork to bring agentic AI execution to business users
top_stories.summary: Snowflake has unveiled Project SnowWork, a new initiative aimed at enabling agentic AI—AI agents capable of executing complex workflows autonomously—across business applications. This move seeks to integrate advanced AI capabilities into day-to-day enterprise operations, expanding the scope and productivity of AI in business settings.

top_stories.title: Google Engineers Launch "Sashiko" for Agentic AI Code Review of the Linux Kernel
top_stories.summary: Google engineers have released 'Sashiko,' a tool designed to leverage agentic AI for code review tasks on the Linux kernel. This technology demonstrates advanced practical applications of LLMs and agentic AI in one of the most critical open-source software infrastructures, reflecting the growing role of AI in enterprise-level software management.

top_stories.title: Qualtrics launches AI panels & hub to speed research
top_stories.summary: Qualtrics has introduced new AI-powered panels and a hub for rapid research, deploying generative AI to accelerate data collection and insights for businesses. This development aims to modernize and streamline the market research industry by integrating advanced AI capabilities into customer and employee feedback systems.

top_stories.title: ICML rejects papers of reviewers who used LLMs despite agreeing not to
top_stories.summary: The International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) reportedly rejected papers from peer reviewers who used Large Language Models (LLMs) to assist with review tasks but had previously agreed not to. This event highlights ongoing debate and evolving policy on the ethical and transparent use of AI in the academic publishing process.
